// Build Claude intent classification prompt
const { transcript, state } = $json;

const historyText = state.history
  .map(h => `${h.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Assistant'}: ${h.content}`)
  .join('\n');

const systemPrompt = `You are an intent classifier for a voice assistant that manages Claude Code sessions on a Raspberry Pi.

Classify the user's speech into ONE of these intents:
- create_session: User wants to start a new coding project/session (e.g., "start a new project", "create my-app", "spin up a session")
- list_sessions: User wants to see what sessions are running (e.g., "what's running", "show sessions", "list projects")
- check_status: User wants status of a specific session (e.g., "how's my-app doing", "status of the project")
- send_message: User wants to send a message/instruction to a running session (e.g., "tell it to...", "add a feature", "fix the bug")
- stop_session: User wants to pause/interrupt a session - Ctrl+C (e.g., "stop", "pause", "interrupt")
- kill_session: User wants to terminate/shut down a session completely (e.g., "kill it", "shut down", "terminate")
- resume_session: User wants to resume a preserved/stopped session (e.g., "resume", "continue", "pick up where we left off")
- get_errors: User wants to check for errors or attention items (e.g., "any errors?", "what needs attention?", "problems?")
- end_call: User wants to end the phone call (e.g., "goodbye", "bye", "hang up", "that's all")
- unknown: Cannot determine intent

Extract these fields if present:
- sessionName: Which project/session name is referenced (null if not mentioned or unclear)
- message: The actual content/instruction to send to Claude (null if not applicable)

Respond with ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:
{"intent": "...", "sessionName": "...", "message": "...", "confidence": 0.0-1.0}`;

const userMessage = historyText
  ? `Conversation so far:\n${historyText}\n\nUser just said: "${transcript}"\n\nClassify the intent.`
  : `User said: "${transcript}"\n\nClassify the intent.`;

return {
  json: {
    systemPrompt,
    userMessage,
    callControlId: $json.callControlId,
    transcript,
    state
  }
};

nodes.name: Claude: Classify Intent
nodes.notes: Uses Haiku for fast, cheap intent classification

nodes.name: Route Intent
nodes.notes: Routes to Pi API calls based on classified intent. Fallback = unknown intent.
